dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Well hello, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I didn't expect to see you again so soon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh, I feel quite at home already.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm, although I feel that "at home" doesn't express my feelings in their entirety.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: "Surprised" is more how I'd describe the feeling I had when I first set eyes on this place.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Exactly that.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: It's more beautiful than I imagined.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: It's been a while since I moved here though, so the initial sense of surprise has mostly worn off. Now, this place feels comfortable, like somewhere I belong.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Heh, who'd have thought...

choices.text: As in, it was a nasty surprise?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: What? Of course not! It was a very pleasant surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You've come to the right person.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Speak your mind. I'm more than happy to keep you company.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm... Though it's too bad we don't have anything to wet our whistles with...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you like to drink so much, Kaeya?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Well... largely because I like the taste.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: But I can't deny that I also like how it makes me feel.

choices.text: I think I understand what you mean.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh really? Just from listening to me describe it? Despite having never tried it yourself?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: That's quite a unique talent.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I have to say, though, that chatting with you is quite intoxicating...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Actually, in much the same way that drinking is.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: So, I suppose... I'm just greedy and want to enjoy both of these pleasures at the same time.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So all in all, I'm just another layer in your cocktail of pleasure?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hahaha... What an interesting metaphor! I hadn't looked at it from that angle...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Let me think...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hmm... Your analogy seems largely correct.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Save for one small detail — you, of course, are the main ingredient in said cocktail.

choices.text: So what you mean is, you drink to numb the pain?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Goodness, look at you, leaping to conclusions... Do I look like I've been through that much?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'm quite content with my life right now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You're already here by my side, what more could I ask for?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Though, I would like to know one thing. Is there any way in which I can be of assistance to you, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: You really have a way with words, Kaeya...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Haha, how flattering!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: As always, I speak only from the heart.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Nothing would make me feel prouder than knowing that my words of advice are of some help to you.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: That would imply that you trust me and proves that I am capable of helping you solve your problems.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: In fact... would you like me to compile a guide for you...?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: It would contain all kinds of practical knowledge for at home and on the road, including the techniques I have developed for communicating with people from all walks of life. I'd like to share it all with you.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hahaha... My pleasure!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'd better get to work then...

choices.text: You never fail to impress me, Kaeya.
Can I rely on your words of wisdom in the future?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'm at your service.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Kaeya.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Morning to you too, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Don't forget that I'm always here for you if you ever need to pour your heart out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Kaeya.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Is it that time already? I'm not sure I'm ready to say goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: But then again... one has to get one's beauty sleep. Alright then, good night.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Promise me that once the grapes ripen, you won't press them into juice. Grapes are best turned into delectable wine.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: ...Heh, I just remembered my days back at the winery.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Why don't I let you in on the secrets of winemaking?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Staying here feels like being in Mondstadt. The only difference is that I won't be bothered by any of my duties as one of the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Imagine bringing a bottle of finely-aged wine here and having a taste... Now, wouldn't that be bliss?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: When that time comes, let's chat as we do right now, friend.
